headline: Today you choose discipline over emotion
summary: You're gaining 0.32kg weekly when you need to lose 0.86kg; today you reverse course with Huel meals and movement.
details: Stop treating Saturday as permission to snack—replace emotional eating with two Huel meals and zero unplanned food today. Get on the rowing machine for 30 minutes; movement is non-negotiable when your schedule is sedentary. This Saturday is where your pattern breaks: you're 1.28kg/week behind target, and every day of reversal compounds toward your 88kg goal by June 8th.
